feature_availability.note: IEEE amounts are in USD major units; currency is not recorded.
TransactionDT is seconds from an undisclosed reference; hour-of-day is only recoverable up to an unknown offset.
D-columns are undocumented timedeltas; none is defined as account age, so using one would invent semantics.
IEEE has no device identifier (DeviceInfo is a model string), so F01 cannot be computed from IEEE-CIS.
Presence of device metadata, not of a device identifier.
card1 is an anonymized card attribute, not a token.
addr1/addr2 are anonymized billing-region codes, not shipping references.

temporal_semantics: Seconds elapsed from an undisclosed reference datetime (not a real timestamp). Monotonic in event time; used for chronological ordering and splitting.
